decisive_items: A core-needle biopsy of the left breast confirmed infiltrative duct cell carcinoma
poorly cohesive clusters of ductal cells with pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli
Cytologic diagnosis was duct cell carcinoma of both breasts with left axillary lymph node metastasis
response.rationale: The left breast has a confirmed infiltrative ductal carcinoma on core biopsy, with malignant cytology and axillary metastasis. The right breast is suspected fibroadenoma but cytology shows malignant features, so the overall diagnosis is infiltrative ductal carcinoma.

rejected.why: Hypertension is a comorbidity, not the presenting diagnosis.
Type 2 diabetes is a comorbidity, not the presenting diagnosis.
Axillary lymph node metastasis is a consequence of the primary cancer, not the primary diagnosis.
Fibroadenoma is suspected for the right breast but not confirmed and contradicted by cytology showing malignant cells.
